notes.text: Eruvin 62a follows סב. under the period convention; no named edition is independently checked.
Giyori is a conventional vocalization of גיורי. בריה explicitly presents Yitzchak as the heading figure’s son, without independent historical verification. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
